instrument: Proposed two-year data center ban, Buffalo Common Council
summary: Common Council adopted as amended on Sept 29, 2026 a resolution calling for a two-year moratorium on new data center projects and no expansions of existing ones, and a nine-member task force, while the city updates zoning and property tax codes. Not yet binding: a local law drafted by Corporation Counsel is expected before the council in early October, with a formal vote to follow. The mayor's office is reviewing the resolution with Corporation Counsel.
notes: Buffalo News reports the moratorium would apply to data centers of 20 MW or more and include crypto-mining and blockchain facilities; resolution not read.  Corroborated: WKBW and Buffalo News both report the 20 MW threshold; six sponsors including Golombek (veto-proof); mayor's office says Corporation Counsel will review if passed. Resolution text not located.
